create_HTML_document: create an HTML document with a title and optional auto-refresh interval using the HTML class
add_header_to_HTML: add a text header to the HTML document using the add_header method
add_images_to_HTML: add a row of clickable images with captions to the HTML document using add_images
add_videos_to_HTML: add a row of clickable video players with captions to the HTML document using add_videos
save_HTML_to_disk: save the generated HTML document to an index.html file on disk using the save method
